title: False tag, license plate, bicycle or moped, penalty.
bodyText: Any person who uses a tag, or license plate, not furnished in accordance with section 249-14 or section 249-14.1, or who counterfeits any such tag, or license plate, or who fraudulently removes such a tag, or license plate, from any bicycle or moped, shall be fined not more than $500.
bodyHtml: §249-17  False tag, license plate, bicycle or moped, penalty.  Any person who uses a tag, or license plate, not furnished in accordance with section 249-14 or section 249-14.1, or who counterfeits any such tag, or license plate, or who fraudulently removes such a tag, or license plate, from any bicycle or moped, shall be fined not more than $500. [L 1896, c 51, pt of §13; RL 1925, §§1310, 1313; RL 1935, §2156; am L 1941, c 268, §20; RL 1945, §5703; RL 1955, §130-15; HRS §249-17; am L 1978, c 175, §6; am L 1988, c 264, §6; am L 2016, c 200, §6]
